'''JK Tyre & Industries Ltd.''' is an Indian [[multinational corporation|multinational]] tyre manufacturing company headquartered in [[New Delhi]]. It is part of [[J.K. Organisation]], an Indian industrial conglomerate, with headquarters in [[Delhi]], [[Kanpur]], and [[Mumbai]]. It was incorporated in 1951 by the [[Singhania family]].

The company is primarily engaged in manufacturing [[tyres]] for [[automobiles]], [[motorcycles]], [[commercial vehicles]], and [[tractor|farm vehicles]]. As of 2026, the company is claimed to be India's third-largest tyre maker by revenue.<ref> {{cite web |url= https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/auto/tyres/jk-tyres-lines-up-rs-4900-crore-capex-plan-till-fy30/articleshow/131340265.cms |title= JK Tyres lines up Rs 4,900 crore capex plan till FY30 |publisher= [[The Economic Times]] |access-date= 30 July 2026}}</ref>

==History==
JK Tyre & Industries was incorporated on 14 February 1951 as a private limited company. It pursued managing agency business until March 1970 before obtaining a letter of intent in February 1972 for manufacturing automobile tyres and tubes.<ref name="ETinfo"> {{cite web |url= https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/jk-tyre-industries-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13537.cms#stocksAbout |title= Company History - JK Tyre & Industries Ltd. | access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref>

The company became a public limited company on 1 April 1974.<ref name="ETinfo"></ref> It was engaged in developing, marketing, and distributing automotive tyres, tubes, flaps, and retreads.<ref name= "BShistory"> {{cite web |url= https://www.business-standard.com/markets/jk-tyre-industries-ltd-share-price-304.html |title= JK Tyre & Industries Ltd |access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref>

==Products==
JK Tyre manufactures a wide range of tyres, including passenger car tyres, motorcycle/scooter tyres, commercial tyres, truck/bus bias tyres, truck/bus radial tyres, [[commercial vehicle|LCV]] tyres, [[Small Commercial Vehicle|SCV]] tyres, farm tyres <ref> {{cite web |url= https://www.constructionweekonline.in/business/jk-tyre-2 |title= JK Tyre strengthens farm portfolio with Shresth Plus |publisher= Construction Week |access-date= 30 July 2026}}</ref>, off-the-road tyres, and three-wheeler tyres.

In 2016, JK Tyre became the first company to manufacture one crore truck [[radial tyres]] from its Vikrant plant in Mysore, Karnataka.<ref name="BS">{{cite web |url= https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/jk-tyre-rolls-out-10-million-radial-tyres-116082201041_1.html |title= JK Tyre rolls out 10 million radial tyres |publisher= [[Business Standard]] |access-date= 30 July 2026}}</ref> The company was also featured in the Limca Book of Records for introducing India’s largest off-road dump truck tyre with a payload capacity of 240 tonnes.<ref name="FE">{{cite web |url= https://www.financialexpress.com/auto/car-news/jk-tyre-enters-limca-book-of-records-for-indias-largest-off-road-dump-truck-tyre/1527003/ |title= JK Tyre enters Limca Book of Records for India’s largest off-road dump truck tyre |publisher= [[The Financial Express (India)|Financial Express]] |access-date= 30 July 2026}}</ref>

In 2022, the company introduced the country's first puncture guard technology in tyres for four-wheelers.<ref> {{cite web |url= https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/auto/tyres/jk-tyre-brings-puncture-guard-technology-in-tyres-for-four-wheelers/articleshow/90420287.cms |title= JK Tyre brings puncture guard technology in tyres for four-wheelers |date= 24 March 2022 | publisher= [[The Economic Times]] |access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref>

In 2023, it developed a new tyre using sustainable and recycled materials. The product was named 'UX Green'. Its comparison is said to be comparable to a standard radial tyre.<ref> {{cite web |url= https://www.indiatoday.in/auto/latest-auto-news/story/jk-tyre-unveils-ux-green-tyre-made-with-sustainable-and-recycled-materials-2364882-2023-04-26 |title= JK Tyre unveils UX Green tyre made with sustainable and recycled materials |publisher= [[India Today]] |date= 26 April 2023|access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref>  

In 2024, the company launched embedded smart tyres for passenger vehicles. The technology is claimed to integrate sensors into the tyre structure to provide real-time data on operating conditions, such as air pressure, temperature, and potential leaks.<ref> {{cite web |url= https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/tyres/revolutionizing-mobility-jk-tyre-launches-indias-first-embedded-smart-tyres-for-passenger-vehicles/125225361 | title= JK Tyre launches embedded smart tyres for passenger vehicles |date= 10 November 2025 |publisher= [[The Economic Times]] |access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref><ref> {{cite web |url= https://www.indiatoday.in/auto/new-launches/story/jk-tyre-introduces-indias-first-tyres-with-embedded-sensors-for-passenger-cars-2816681-2025-11-10 |title= JK Tyre introduces India's first tyres with embedded sensors for passenger cars |date= 10 November 2025 |access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref>

==Manufacturing units==
JK Tyre is claimed to have nine manufacturing plants in India and two in [[Mexico]].<ref name= "BShistory"></ref> The plants in India are located in:
*Mysore, Karnataka
* [[Banmore]], Madhya Pradesh <ref> {{cite web |url= https://www.fortuneindia.com/business-news/jk-tyre-invests-over-1000-crore-to-augment-banmore-units-capacity-to-105-million-pcr-tyres-a-year/129465 |title = JK Tyre invests over ₹1,000 crore to augment Banmore unit’s capacity to 10.5 million PCR tyres a year |publisher = [[Fortune India]] |access-date = 30 July 2026}}</ref>
* Kankroli, Rajasthan
* [[Chennai]], Tamil Nadu<ref> {{cite web |url= https://www.motorindiaonline.in/jk-tyres-chennai-plant-a-future-ready-premiumisation-first-playbook-for-growth/ |title= JK Tyre’s Chennai plant: A Future-ready, Premiumisation-first Playbook for Growth |date= 17 December 2025 |publisher= MotorIndia |access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref>
* Haridwar, Uttarakhand

==Awards and recognition==
* '''2009''': Export Excellence Award, Federation of Karnataka, Chambers of Commerce & Industry
* '''2016''': Trusted Brand (Gold Category) by [[Reader's Digest]]
* '''2020''': National Energy Management Award by [[Confederation of Indian Industry]]<ref> {{cite web |url= https://www.motorindiaonline.in/jk-tyre-honoured-by-cii-for-sustainable-manufacturing-practices/ |title= JK Tyre honoured by CII for sustainable manufacturing practices |date= 15 January 2021 |access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref>
* '''2020''': National Award for Excellence in Water Management at Kankroli Plant by [[Confederation of Indian Industry]]
* '''2020''': Iconic Brand of India by [[The Economic Times]]
* '''2024''': Asia-Pacific Climate Awards by [[Financial Times]] and [[Statista]]<ref> {{cite web |url= https://www.ft.com/climate-leaders-asia-pacific-2024?syn-25a6b1a6=1 |title= Asia-Pacific Climate Leaders 2024: interactive listing |date=5 June 2024 |publisher= [[Financial Times]] |access-date= 4 August 2026}}</ref>
